description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for Git rebase routines in the libgit2 library, including rebase options, operations, and control functions.

methods.name: git_rebase_init_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_rebase_options structure with default values.

methods.name: git_rebase_init
methods.description: Creates a new rebase object for rebasing specified commits.

methods.name: git_rebase_open
methods.description: Opens an existing rebase in progress.

methods.name: git_rebase_operation_entrycount
methods.description: Returns the total number of rebase operations.

methods.name: git_rebase_operation_current
methods.description: Returns the index of the current rebase operation.

methods.name: git_rebase_operation_byindex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific rebase operation by index.

methods.name: git_rebase_inmemory_index
methods.description: Gets the index after the last rebase operation for in-memory rebases.

methods.name: git_rebase_commit
methods.description: Commits the current patch during rebase.

methods.name: git_rebase_abort
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing rebase, restoring previous state.
